name: What kind of antique trim can Maine Results, Inc. repair?

mainEntity.name: What kind of antique trim can Maine Results, Inc. repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maine Results, Inc. specializes in repairing a variety of antique trim types commonly found in homes across Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, and Star. This includes delicate Victorian-era moldings, Craftsman-style casings, and period-specific baseboards. We often encounter original wood trim that has suffered from water damage, age-related cracking, or impact. Our approach focuses on restoring the original character and integrity of the architectural details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maine Results, Inc. repairs various antique trim types like Victorian moldings, Craftsman casings, and period baseboards, focusing on restoring original character.
